GOV-F-004-S56.title: Audit Logging Integration with Tool Router and Facades
GOV-F-004-S56.description: Integrate the audit logging service into the tool_router and application facades to capture all GPT and Claude tool invocations, including inputs, outputs, and decision metadata.

GOV-F-004-S57.title: Append-Only Enforcement Guards at Database Layer
GOV-F-004-S57.description: Implement database-level protections (e.g., MongoDB schema validation, restricted roles, or write rules) to prevent update and delete operations on audit log collections outside controlled append operations.
